# Narrative Reference Frame

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:NarrativeReferenceFrame`](gmeow-NarrativeReferenceFrame.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/NarrativeReferenceFrame>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/narrative`](../../slices/narrative.md)

A canon, continuity, or narrative realm that serves as a reference frame for in-universe facts (locations, dates, events) and functionally as the standpoint under which in-universe claims hold true. The Harry Potter canon, the Marvel Multiverse (Earth-616, MCU, Ultimate), and the Star Wars Legends/Canon split are all narrative reference frames. Ordinary GMEOW entities ([`Person`](gmeow-Person.md), [`Place`](gmeow-Place.md), [`Organization`](gmeow-Organization.md), [`Event`](gmeow-Event.md)) may carry claims according to this frame; cross-continuity variants are linked by [`counterpartOf`](../properties/gmeow-counterpartOf.md), never merged.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:NarrativeScope`](gmeow-NarrativeScope.md), [`gmeow:ReferenceFrame`](gmeow-ReferenceFrame.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:NarrativeReferenceFrame`](gmeow-NarrativeReferenceFrame.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:NarrativeScope`](gmeow-NarrativeScope.md), [`gmeow:ReferenceFrame`](gmeow-ReferenceFrame.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
